passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.section: Income approach, summary of the guide
passages.text: The guide emphasizes the widespread use of risk adjusted Net Present Value (rNPV), which applies success probabilities at each clinical and regulatory milestone to model potential outcomes credibly.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: The rNPV, also known as the probability-weighted expected return method or expected NPV method, is a refinement of the discounted cash flow approach, where future cash flows are adjusted based on their probability of success.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: Here, we separate the cost of capital from the probability of success of the project development.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: The discount rate should not reflect the drug’s specific risk profile, including factors such as the stage of development, market potential and regulatory uncertainties, as these factors have been incorporated into the set of cash flows and probabilities.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: However, one major drawback of solely adjusting the discount rate to account for project risk is that the effects of risk are not explicitly visible in the valuation output.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: Assumptions used in cash flow development must be data-driven.

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 3: The income approach (web publication; official WIPO text; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: The rNPV is the most popular, and therefore de facto valuation method for biotechnology assets and firms, and can be calculated using the formula in Equation 2.

passages.source_title: IVSC. International Valuation Standards effective 31 January 2025, RED-LINE EDITION (copy hosted by ICAEW; each registered passage also appears word for word in the January 2022 edition, so it is unchanged text)
passages.section: IVS 103 Valuation Approaches, income approach, discount rate
passages.text: In developing a discount rate, the valuer must: (a) document the method used for developing the discount rate and support its use, (b) provide evidence for the derivation of the discount rate, including the identification of the significant inputs and support for their derivation or source.

passages.source_title: IVSC. International Valuation Standards effective 31 January 2025, RED-LINE EDITION (copy hosted by ICAEW; each registered passage also appears word for word in the January 2022 edition, so it is unchanged text)
passages.text: Specifically, the valuer must evaluate whether the risk underlying the forecast cash flow assumptions are captured in the discount rate.

passages.source_title: IVSC. International Valuation Standards effective 31 January 2025, RED-LINE EDITION (copy hosted by ICAEW; each registered passage also appears word for word in the January 2022 edition, so it is unchanged text)
passages.text: The compensation for bearing such risk should be incorporated into the expected payoff through a cash flow risk margin or the discount rate.

passages.source_title: IVSC. International Valuation Standards effective 31 January 2025, RED-LINE EDITION (copy hosted by ICAEW; each registered passage also appears word for word in the January 2022 edition, so it is unchanged text)
passages.text: For example, intangible assets used in research and development activities may be higher risk than those used in delivering existing products or services

passages.source_title: WIPO. Intellectual Property Valuation in Biotechnology and Pharmaceuticals, chapter 4: The real options method (web publication; a guide, not a standard)
passages.text: This is the key advantage of a real options valuation over an NPV calculation: the real options method explicitly considers flexibility and different future pathways for the project.
